Dependency.description: A package that another one runs: its steps call `../ID.jevblock/flow.json`.

id.description: The id of the package that is needed.

source.description: An https address to install it from when it is missing.

version.description: The versions that work: `*` for any; `1.2.0` or `=1.2.0` for exactly that one; `^1.2.0` for 1.2.0 up to 2.0.0 (up to 0.3.0 for `^0.2.0`); `~1.2.0`, `1.2.x` or `1.x` for a series; or comparisons with `>=`, `>`, `<` and `<=` joined by spaces or commas, like `>=1.2.0 <2.0.0`.

PackageInput.description: What a package asks for each time its block is used: one `${input.NAME}` of its steps.

default.description: What the input holds when the test doesn't say.

label.description: What to call it in the editor, when `name` isn't clear enough.

name.description: The `NAME` of `${input.NAME}`: letters, digits and `_`, not starting with a digit.

description: A block that people share: `block.json` in the folder `ID.jevblock`, next to `flow.json` with the steps of the block.

dependencies.description: Other packages the steps run, which must be installed beside this one.

description.description: What the block does, in a sentence or two.

format.description: Version of the layout of the file. JEVision doesn't open a file in a format newer than it knows.

icon.description: SF Symbol the block is shown with, such as `person.crop.circle`.

id.description: Like `com.acme.sign-in`: at least three parts of lowercase letters, digits and `-`, joined by dots. The folder of the installed package is named after it.

inputs.description: What the block asks for each time a test uses it: one entry for every `${input.NAME}` of its steps.

license.description: Name of the license, such as `MIT`.

minVersion.description: Oldest JEVision that can run the block.

name.description: What the block is called in the library.

version.description: Version of the block: `MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`, with an optional `-pre.release` part.

title: JEVision block package
